_comment: Words a setter rejected as answers, and why. tools/grid_fill.py vetoes
them, so a bad answer is never rediscovered — the same principle STYLE.md
applies to feedback: encode it once. Add to this file rather than patching
a fill by hand, and always give a REASON: the reason is what tells the next
Most entries here exist because Lufz folds proper nouns into lowercase
entries, so a name is indistinguishable from a common noun by case alone
(exetLexicon.isProperNoun only inspects capitalisation, which is why it
cannot help here). Until there is a better signal, names get caught here.

unclueable.AMINO: never stands alone in English - it is only ever half of 'amino acid', so there is no honest definition to write
unclueable.ERIC: a first name; the archaic Irish blood-fine sense is far too obscure to define in a daily
unclueable.MARC: reads as the first name; the only common-noun sense (grape residue and the brandy from it) is too specialist for a daily
unclueable.PARC: French, and in English only inside place names - no fair definition exists
unclueable.PROTO: a prefix, not a free-standing word - fine as a charade PIECE, never as an answer
unclueable.SEGA: a company name, so a trademark rather than a word; a daily cryptic should not require brand knowledge
